summary: Research the biologically-correct SimuCell3D organoid cell-aggregation mechanism to replace the rejected forced-confinement hack

result.what_was_wrong: `AggregationDrive` (dcm_gpu_build.py:102-156) applies on EVERY membrane node a global harmonic body force F=-k_agg*(pos-center) toward a single FIXED point captured once from the t=0 centroid (production wiring dcm_two_stage_production.py:165-169). This is biologically wrong on three counts. (a) It is an EXTERNAL central potential well, not cell physics — it carries zero cell-cell information; it would compact a bag of sand identically. Real hanging-drop aggregation comes from TWO ingredients cells generate themselves: their OWN persistent active motility (search) + MUTUAL cadherin adhesion (capture), confined by a non-adhesive boundary. No external agent ever pulls cells to a point. (b) A central pull is a LUMPED PROXY FOR SURFACE TENSION — exactly the abstracted-over-mechanistic choice CLAUDE.md forbids. It imposes a tissue-scale density/pressure gradient maximal at the centre, so it (i) over-compacts the core and pre-strains cortex/turgor against a phantom load, (ii) MANUFACTURES the rounding that should emerge from the adhesion+cortex (γ/β) balance — the ball shape is set by k_agg, not by differential adhesion, and (iii) destroys cell sorting (DAH): a force identical for all cells overwhelms the tiny cadherin differentials that drive sorting. (c) It empirically never aggregated: ~25000 accelerated steps with Rg shrinking only ~13% = a tiny elastic compression of an already-near-equilibrium cluster against the well, then arrest (inward pull balanced by turgor+excluded volume before cells coalesce). At dt=1e-9 s and S=6e5 (common/sim_realtime.py), 25000 steps = 25 µs sim ≈ 15 REAL SECONDS vs the 12-48 HOURS real aggregation takes — ~10^4× too short to express any aggregation kinetics. The fix: delete AggregationDrive and the central-pull wiring; aggregation must EMERGE from active motility + adhesion inside a force-free-interior confining boundary.
result.aggregation_model: Active-matter COALESCENCE (search-and-capture), NOT a central attractor. Three stacked, independently-validated ingredients, none referencing a centre point: (1) DRIVING/search — each cell is a self-propelled particle (SPP): an internally-generated traction f_active along a per-cell polarity vector p_i that reorients with a persistence time tau_p. Motility raises the cell-cell COLLISION rate far above passive diffusion, so cells encounter and stick; aggregation is BALLISTIC (encounter-time ~1/v0), which is why real aggregation is hours not weeks (arXiv:2508.11793; Belmonte 2008 PRL — even moderate self-propulsion 'considerably speeds up' coalescence). NO Vicsek alignment coupling (J=0): collective order EMERGES from contact mechanics (Garcia 2015 / Henkes; matches in-repo layer2_plithotaxis). (2) BINDING/capture — the existing bilinear-tent cell-cell adhesion (DcmTentContactGPU) captures any two cells motility brings within c_adh; cadherin adhesion co-acting with active cortical tension (here the edge-spring proxy + turgor) sets the tissue surface tension that ROUNDS the liquid-like aggregate by interfacial-free-energy minimization (Steinberg DAH; Manning 2010 PNAS γ/β crossover ~2). (3) CONFINING/drop — a SOFT SPHERICAL WALL (force-free interior, inward only at r>R_drop) emulating the hanging-drop air-liquid meniscus: it bounds the search and raises local density so cell-cell adhesion outcompetes escape, but imposes NO interior gradient and does NOT manufacture surface tension. Net: cells wander (motility) → collide → stick (tent adhesion) → the bound cluster rounds (γ/β) → the wall keeps the search bounded so a SINGLE aggregate forms. The final ball size/shape is the EMERGENT adhesion-cortex-turgor balance, not a stiffness knob. Seed cells already within cadherin reach (spacing 2.0-2.6·R) so the tent engages early and motility closes the small remaining gaps — but the ball is NOT pre-assembled; it coalesces.
result.motility_force: New HOOMD Custom force `DcmActiveMotilitySPP(md.force.Custom)`, modelled on the device-dispatch + per-cell-centroid pattern of DcmActiveRimTractionGPU (dcm_gpu_forces.py:223). PER-CELL self-propulsion (one polarity per cell, NOT per-node, NOT toward any centre), distributed over that cell's nodes. State: a host-resident polarity array `p` shape (n_cells,3), unit vectors, seeded random (np.random.default_rng(seed)). set_forces(timestep): (1) via DeviceDispatch.snapshot read typeid+position as xp(cupy/numpy); (2) for each LIVE cell c with node-range ranges[c] (skip dormant typeid != mem_typeid), write arr.force[nodes] += (f_active/nv)*p[c] — equal share over that cell's nv live nodes so the NET force on the cell is exactly f_active*p_c; (3) ramp f_active in over ramp_steps and f_cap-cap per node (BAOAB int32 guard, identical to the rim class). MAGNITUDE: f_active≈S*v_m*gamma_cell≈6e5*1µm/min*1.64e-8 N·s/m≈1.6e-10 N/cell ⇒ ~3.9e-12 N/node over 42 nodes (same order as rim f_act=1.2e-10 N/node, < contact_force_cap=5e-8 N). DIRECTION-PERSISTENCE update (BAOAB-safe, done on HOST at low cadence, e.g. reorient_every=100-500 steps in a SEPARATE hoomd.custom.Action updater, NOT in set_forces so the hot per-step path stays force-only): an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck/rotational-diffusion step on the heading — for each cell draw a Gaussian vector, project it onto the plane perpendicular to p_c, p_c <- normalize(p_c + sqrt(2*D_r_eff*dt_reorient)*xi_perp), then renormalise to unit length. D_r_eff = S/tau_p (tau_p≈10-30 min) so the heading decorrelates on the accelerated clock, preserving L_p/R. Renormalise-to-unit keeps |p|=1 exactly (no drift); because the polarity update is decoupled from the integrator sub-steps the force is piecewise-constant between reorientations (like the existing ramped rim traction) and never destabilises BAOAB. Optional CIL (bias reorientation away from neighbour-density gradient) DEFAULT-OFF.
result.confinement: SOFT ONE-SIDED SPHERICAL WALL = the hanging-drop / U-well meniscus. New Custom force `DcmDropConfinement(md.force.Custom)`, device-dispatched like SettlingForce. Force law per live membrane node at distance r from the drop centre c_drop: F=0 for r<=R_drop (FORCE-FREE INTERIOR), and F=-k_wall*(r-R_drop)*r_hat for r>R_drop, capped at f_cap. c_drop = the live cluster centroid recomputed at LOW cadence (e.g. every 1000 steps) OR a fixed lab-frame point if the drop is anchored — either is fine because the interior is force-free so the exact centre barely matters. This is categorically different from AggregationDrive: (i) it is a BOUNDARY (acts only at r>R_drop), not a body force filling the volume; (ii) the interior imposes NO density/pressure gradient, does NOT pre-strain turgor/cortex, and does NOT manufacture surface tension — it only stops wandering cells escaping to infinity, exactly as a drop's air-liquid meniscus does. Optional thin adhesive lip (weak attractive band just inside R_drop) for a wetting meniscus — DEFAULT-OFF. EXPLICITLY NOT a central pull: there is NO -k*(pos-center) term anywhere in the interior. R_drop is sized a few cell diameters larger than the target packed ball so the wall guides without crushing (R_drop≈(cbrt(N)+2)*R_cell). Equally valid alternative: a periodic/bounded box with adhesion strong enough that motile cells self-trap once a seed forms — but the soft drop is the faithful in-vitro analog and is preferred.
result.adhesion: KEEP the existing validated cohesive bilinear-tent DcmTentContactGPU bands unchanged — they are already correct and were the subject of the 2026-06-11 cohesion fix. Hard invariant (the single decisive correctness condition, dcm_cohesion_check.py): r_contact < c_adh, else the adhesion band [r_contact, c_adh) is EMPTY and cohesion is silently DEAD (the actual 2026-06-11 bug: c_adh=0.5µm < r_contact=mean_edge=4.37µm). Current defaults satisfy this: rep_strength ξ=2.0e8 Pa/m, adh_strength ω=8.0e8 Pa/m (strong cohesion), c_adh=5.0e-6 m (tent peaks at c_adh/2=2.5µm), r_contact=r_contact_factor·mean_edge=1.0·mean_edge≈4.37µm at subdiv 1, contact_force_cap=5.0e-8 N. The tent gives short-range repulsion (non-penetration) for d<r_contact and short-range adhesion (cohesion) for r_contact<=d<c_adh; it HOLDS/COMPACTS touching cells but cannot span a gap — which is exactly why motility (not a pull) is needed to bring cells into the band. UPGRADE PATH (opt-in, not required for first correct run): swap the symmetric tent adhesion for the in-repo Rakshit-2012 E-cadherin catch-bond (validation/cadherin_sliding_rebinding.py, f0≈29 pN) for the faithful force-dependent cohesion — mechanistic over lumped. No change to the repulsion branch. Cell-substrate adhesion (DcmSubstrateForceGPU) stays OFF during Stage-1 aggregation (free-float drop) and is turned ON only for Stage-2 spreading.
result.parameters: DCM build: nv=42 nodes/cell (subdiv 1), R_cell=7.5µm (MCF7), gamma_node=3.9e-10 N·s/m, dt=1e-9 s, kT=4.28e-21 J (310 K), S=6e5 (common/sim_realtime, report explicitly — no magic number). MOTILITY: gamma_cell=nv*gamma_node=1.64e-8 N·s/m. Smeets 2016 PNAS MCF10A v_m=1 µm/min ⇒ BARE f_active=v_m*gamma_cell=2.7e-16 N/cell (invisible on the mechanical clock — this is why kinetic acceleration is mandatory). At the accelerated clock: f_active≈S*2.7e-16≈1.6e-10 N/cell ⇒ ~3.9e-12 N/node over 42 nodes — same order as the existing rim traction f_act=1.2e-10 N/node, well under contact_force_cap=5e-8 N (BAOAB-safe). Persistence tau_p≈10-30 min ⇒ bare D_r≈5.6e-4–1.7e-3 /s; apply S to the rotational clock (D_r_eff=S/tau_p) so heading decorrelates on the accelerated timescale; reorient_every≈100-500 steps. INITIAL POLARITIES: random unit vectors, seed-controlled. CONFINING DROP: R_drop≈(cbrt(N)+2)*R_cell (N=200 ⇒ ~8*R_cell≈60µm); k_wall≈k_edge=1e-3 N/m (cortex-stiffness scale), f_cap≈5e-9 N/node. ADHESION (unchanged): ξ=2e8, ω=8e8 Pa/m, c_adh=5e-6 m > r_contact≈4.37µm, contact_force_cap=5e-8 N. Turgor dP0=133 Pa, K_vol=1e3 Pa, V0=(4/3)πR³; k_edge=1e-3 N/m cortex. SEEDING: spacing_factor=2.0-2.6·R (within cadherin reach so the tent engages early; motility closes the gaps). Substrate OFF in Stage 1.
biological_criteria: r_contact < c_adh (adhesion band non-empty) — the hard gate; if violated cohesion is DEAD and nothing else matters (dcm_cohesion_check.py band_ok).

Contact-node fraction rises to >~0.7: fraction of live nodes within c_adh of a node of a DIFFERENT cell (the SimuCell3D confluence observable) — proves cells are truly adhered cell-to-cell, not separated spheres.

Radius of gyration Rg of cell centroids DECREASES from the loose seed then PLATEAUS to a bounded value (dRg/dt below tolerance over a window): a cohesive cluster holds Rg flat as adhesion balances repulsion; a non-cohesive one disperses (Rg grows). Aggregation = real Rg drop + plateau, NOT a 13% elastic squeeze.

Asphericity → ~0 (the aggregate ROUNDS into a ball) — and critically, the rounding is driven by the adhesion-cortex-turgor (γ/β) balance, verifiable by removing the wall and confirming the ball STAYS rounded (it must NOT relax, because no external field is holding the shape).
Single connected aggregate (one cluster, not many small clusters): nearest-neighbour cell-spacing distribution unimodal at ~contact distance, no isolated cells outside the drop.
Volume conservation V/V0 stays ~1 (turgor held, no collapse/blow-up) and max per-node speed finite (explosion guard).

Mechanism check (NEGATIVE control): with motility OFF, a loose seed must NOT aggregate (stays dispersed) — proving aggregation is motility-driven, not wall-driven; with the wall removed AND adhesion on, an already-coalesced ball must stay cohesive (Rg flat) — proving cohesion is adhesion, not confinement.
result.steps_needed: Run TO CONVERGENCE, not a fixed budget. Mapping (dt=1e-9 s, S=6e5, t_real=S·dt·steps): ~6e6 steps per 1 h real, ~7.2e7 per 12 h, ~1.4e8 per 24 h, ~2.9e8 per 48 h. Real hanging-drop aggregation is 12-48 h (initial coalescence in hours, full rounding/compaction over a day+; Smyrek 2019, Lin 2006). Target the initial-coalescence window: run Stage-1 for O(1e7-1e8) accelerated steps (~2-24 h real). STOP CONDITION is convergence, NOT step count: stop when (a) Rg plateaus — dRg/dt below tolerance over a trailing window, (b) contact fraction >~0.7, and (c) asphericity → ~0. Sample diagnostics every ~1e4-1e5 steps. ALWAYS report t_sim AND t_real side-by-side with S stated (sim_realtime honesty rule). The failed 25000-step run (25 µs sim ≈ 15 s real) was ~10^4× too short — that alone explains the ~13% non-aggregation. For a fast CPU dev smoke-test, a few×1e5 steps is enough to confirm the FORM (Rg decreasing, contact fraction climbing) before committing the GPU production run.
result.all_cells_full_physics: EVERY cell runs the SAME full physics — no activity-LOD freezing, no outer-layer-only or 3-zone abstraction. Concretely: (1) the SPP motility force iterates over ALL live cells (cell_of_node>=0 / typeid==mem_typeid) with no rim/interior split and no neighbour-crowding gate — unlike DcmActiveRimTractionGPU which deliberately excludes interior cells (contact inhibition), aggregation motility applies to every cell because dispersed cells must ALL wander to find neighbours. Do NOT reuse the rim-detection branch for Stage 1. (2) Do NOT enable DcmActivityLOD (dcm_gpu_lod.py) during aggregation — every cell carries its own polarity, gets its own active force, and its own turgor/tent/edge-spring physics. The single membrane particle type (one BAOAB gamma entry) already means turgor/contact/edge-spring are O(nodes) device kernels over ALL nodes uniformly, so 'all cells full physics' is the natural state — LOD is the thing to NOT turn on. (3) The polarity array is sized (n_cells,3) covering all cells; dormant/parked pool nodes (typeid != mem_typeid) get zero force via the same typeid mask used by SettlingForce. (4) Verify in the diagnostic: every live cell has |f_active*p_c|>0 (no cell silently frozen) and the contact-fraction/Rg observables are computed over ALL live nodes, not a subset.
implementation_plan: STEP 0 (delete the wrong mechanism): remove class AggregationDrive (dcm_gpu_build.py:102-156) and its wiring in dcm_two_stage_production.py:165-169 (the agg_center capture + forces.append). Remove the --k-agg argument. This is the central-pull hack PI forbids.

STEP 1 (motility force): add class DcmActiveMotilitySPP(md.force.Custom) to dcm_gpu_forces.py, copying the DeviceDispatch + per-cell-range pattern from DcmActiveRimTractionGPU. Constructor: (cell_of_node, ranges, n_cells, f_active, f_cap, ramp_steps, mem_typeid, seed). Hold polarity p=(n_cells,3) unit vectors on host. set_forces: zero arr.force, then for each live cell add (ramp*f_active/nv_live)*p[c] to that cell's live nodes, f_cap-cap per node. ALL live cells, no rim gate.

STEP 2 (polarity updater): add class DcmPolarityUpdater(hoomd.custom.Action) (a periodic Updater, cadence reorient_every) that does the OU/rotational-diffusion step on each cell's p: draw Gaussian, project perpendicular to p, p<-normalize(p+sqrt(2*(S/tau_p)*dt_reorient)*xi_perp). Decoupled from the per-step force path → BAOAB-safe. Seed-controlled RNG.

STEP 3 (confining drop): add class DcmDropConfinement(md.force.Custom) to dcm_gpu_build.py (device-dispatched like SettlingForce). c_drop = low-cadence cluster centroid (or fixed). F=0 for r<=R_drop; F=-k_wall*(r-R_drop)*r_hat for r>R_drop, capped. Mask to mem_typeid. NO interior term.

STEP 4 (wire Stage 1): in dcm_two_stage_production.py Stage 1, build with active=False (rim) BUT append DcmActiveMotilitySPP + DcmPolarityUpdater + DcmDropConfinement instead of AggregationDrive. with_substrate=False, settle_force=0 (free-float drop). Seed spacing 2.0-2.6·R. Report S, t_sim, t_real.

STEP 5 (convergence loop): replace the fixed n_frames*spf step budget with a CONVERGENCE loop — run in chunks, after each chunk compute Rg, contact_fraction, asphericity (reuse dcm_cohesion_check._contact_fraction / _rg and the asphericity calc); stop when Rg plateaus AND contact_fraction>0.7 AND asphericity<tol, or a max-step safety cap. Log t_sim/t_real each chunk.

STEP 6 (verify cohesion, biological criteria): extend dcm_cohesion_check.py to (a) assert band_ok (r_contact<c_adh), (b) NEGATIVE control: motility-OFF seed must NOT aggregate, (c) wall-removal control: coalesced ball stays cohesive (Rg flat) → proves cohesion is adhesion not confinement. All over ALL live nodes.
STEP 7 (parity test): add tests/test_dcm_motility_gpu_parity.py — CPU numpy path bit-identical to a reference (max abs force diff <1e-12 N), mirroring test_dcm_active_gpu_parity.py.
STEP 8 (CPU smoke + GPU production): CPU dev smoke (~few×1e5 steps) to confirm Rg decreasing + contact fraction climbing; then gbook A5000 GPU production to convergence (O(1e7-1e8) steps), monitored.

STEP 9 (figures + closeout): regenerate figures (Rg(t), contact-fraction(t), asphericity(t), aggregate morphology snapshots) per the visualize-at-closeout rule into outputs; hand the converged COHESIVE aggregate to Stage-2 spreading (substrate ON, rim traction ON, drop+motility OFF). Update Notion Dev Logs.
